SELECT 
    "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."NCODE", "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."DDATE", "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."NAMOUNT", "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."VNAR", "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."NBAG", "FIN_ACCOUNT_MASTER"."NDEDUCTION_CODE", "FIN_ACCOUNT_MASTER"."VDEDUCTION_NAME", "FIN_INDIVIDUAL_MASTER"."NCODE", "FIN_INDIVIDUAL_MASTER"."VNAME"
FROM
    "BGK"."MILK_LEDGER_OP" "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP",
    "BGK"."MILK_DEDUCTION_MASTER" "FIN_ACCOUNT_MASTER",
    "BGK"."MILK_SUPPLIER" "FIN_INDIVIDUAL_MASTER"
WHERE
    "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."NDEDUCTION_CODE" = "FIN_ACCOUNT_MASTER"."NDEDUCTION_CODE" AND
    "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."NCODE" = "FIN_INDIVIDUAL_MASTER"."NCODE"
ORDER BY
    "FIN_ACCOUNT_MASTER"."NDEDUCTION_CODE" ASC,
    "FIN_INDIVIDUAL_MASTER"."NCODE" ASC,
    "FIN_TEMP_LEDGER_OP"."DDATE" ASC
